title: Dehydrative formation and biological evaluation of allylic sulfonamides from allylic alcohols using recyclable silica-supported acid catalysts
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,17880-17894
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01478J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Zachary C. Brandeburg, Kourtney L. Koster, Bhavya Krishnan, Brian Y. Yang, Hannah Zhou, Jacob T. Sinkwich, Patrick M. Kampmeyer, Robert J. Sheaff, Angus A. Lamar
A reusable transition-metal-free catalytic system has been developed to prepare allylic sulfonamides from allylic alcohols under mild reaction conditions. The biological properties of the novel compounds are investigated.
